Subject: Request: case study excerpt + logo use for product announcement

Hi Sergio,

Congrats on the successful pilot — the product launch team at Zenora would like to include Redwood in the partner section of our press release. Specifically we'd like: 
- Permission to use Redwood's logo (web and print)
- A short (1-2 sentence) customer quote about performance/cost impact we can attribute to "Zenora Health"
- Approval for a case study PDF to be linked from the press release landing page

Procurement (Paul) will issue the PO today for the order form; legal (Sandra) copied so we can handle any redlines. Our PR timeline is tight: draft press release goes live 2027-06-01 (we can accommodate a 7-10 day approval window).

Additionally, our comms team asks for evidence of security posture (SOC 2) to include in a partner trust blurb. Can you send (redacted) SOC2 Type II and high-res logos?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if that helps.

— Ava

Quick summary of what we need to align on from Redwood's side: 
1) Security evidence: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (attached).
2) Logo assets: we'll send a branded pack (PNG/SVG) and usage guidelines — attached as zip.
3) Quote approval: please draft the 1-2 sentence quote and send back for legal/PO sign-off. Redwood needs final approval on wording and attribution.

I've attached SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf and zenora_logo_pack.zip. Dev (cc) — FYI on any screenshots/data we should include in the case study (cost/savings metrics). Marissa, can you own the approval once legal signs off?

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: case study excerpt + logo use for product announcement

Team — routing to capture action items and proposed legal language. High level: we can accommodate the customer but will limit scope to protect confidential data and our benchmarks. Proposed items for the MSA/order form or a one-page publicity addendum: 

- Permitted uses: Zenora may use Redwood's name and logo for press release, website partner page, and marketing collateral. Use must follow attached Redwood Brand Guidelines (standard).
- Attribution/quote: any customer quote must be provided in writing and approved by Redwood within 7 business days. Redwood may reasonably withhold approval if the quote contains confidential performance metrics or inaccurate technical claims.
- Embargo and approvals: agree to a 14-day approval window by default; include an option (customer-requested) to extend to 30 days, subject to order form checkbox.
- Confidentiality carveouts: Redwood will not require Zenora to withhold non-sensitive information. Any content that refers to Zenora's confidential patient data or regulated workloads must be redacted.
- Evidence: SOC2 redacted summary is fine to provide. We will not provide underlying raw logs or audit artifacts.
- Indemnity/endorsement: explicitly state that a quote does not create an endorsement and Zenora will not imply Redwood is responsible for Zenora's regulatory compliance.

Action items: 
- Sergio: confirm you will upload the brand guidelines and a one-page publicity addendum template to the linked SharePoint.
- Dev: prepare a short metric screenshot (anonymized) for the case study and confirm it contains no PHI/PII.
- Marissa: once PR draft received, coordinate internal marketing signoff and attach final MSA addendum to the deal record.

I'll draft the one-page addendum and circulate for review by EOD today. If Zenora insists on 30-day embargo in the order form, add a clause that delays any public quoting until both parties sign the addendum.

— Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
